What is expected, running, blocked, controllable, and evidenced across the machine graph?
What reconciled capital, exposure, liability, and account truth exists?
What canonical universe and source-quality evidence feeds decisions?
What exact symbol chronology, uncertainty, decisions, and outcome are correlated?
What Basis evidence, economics, feasibility, proposal, and lifecycle truth exists?
What Volume transition, evidence, uncertainty, proposal, and outcome truth exists?
Why was each proposal accepted, capped, rejected, expired, or invalidated?
What borrow availability, liability, interest, freshness, and linkage truth exists?
What execution owner, fencing, action lifecycle, ambiguity, and recovery truth exists?
What requested, acknowledged, filled, ambiguous, and reconciled order truth exists?
What exposure, exit capacity, lifecycle, and forensic position truth exists?

What deduplicated root-cause incident needs action and what proves recovery?
